name: DeadPoly
start: mkdir -p "DeadPoly/Saved/Config/WindowsServer" ; [ -e "DeadPoly/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Engine.ini" ] || { mkdir -p "$(dirname "DeadPoly/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Engine.ini")"; cp -rn "DeadPoly/Saved/1 RENAME Config/WindowsServer/Engine.ini" "DeadPoly/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Engine.ini" 2>/dev/null; } ; [ -e "DeadPoly/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Game.ini" ] || { mkdir -p "$(dirname "DeadPoly/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Game.ini")"; cp -rn "DeadPoly/Saved/1 RENAME Config/WindowsServer/Game.ini" "DeadPoly/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Game.ini" 2>/dev/null; } ; [ -e "DeadPoly/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/GameUserSettings.ini" ] || { mkdir -p "$(dirname "DeadPoly/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/GameUserSettings.ini")"; cp -rn "DeadPoly/Saved/1 RENAME Config/WindowsServer/GameUserSettings.ini" "DeadPoly/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/GameUserSettings.ini" 2>/dev/null; } ; SteamAppId="1621070" wine "./DeadPoly/Binaries/Win64/DeadPolyServer.exe" DeadPoly -Port={{port}} -stdout -FullStdOutLogOutput -nosteam
ready: ^\[[\d.]+-[\d\.:]+\]\[[\d ]+\]LogRedpointEOS: Verbose: CreateSession: Successfully created session '.*' with ID '.*'$
notes: Aus den AMP-Vorlagen von CubeCoders erzeugt (MIT), noch nicht im Selbsttest geprüft. Läuft über Wine.
